exposure: atonic postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) during cesarean delivery
outcome: Efficacy in controlling atonic postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 39 women with severe postpartum bleeding from uterine inertia during cesarean delivery who underwent a uterine folding hemostasis
finding: Uterine folding hemostasis was effective in controlling atonic postpartum hemorrhage in most cases (82.1%), appeared safe, and did not affect subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Uterine folding hemostasis was found to be a safe and effective technique for controlling atonic postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean delivery.
